A lot more to do in the village: a things-to-do list, snow angels, rooms inside the igloos, games by the fire, a ski trip and a drive, team snowball fights and a scorecard. Also a save file, a web version, and on Android the wallpaper is now the game's own village.

**Moving about**
- **Space held jumps higher**, up to four times as high as a tap.
- **No more falling through roofs.** A jump that steers along a sloping roof lands on it, and so does a jump from a row or two in front of a house.
- **Trees are easy to climb.** Space at the foot of a tall tree leaps onto the lowest branch in reach. **W** up on a tree climbs it branch by branch to the star (on a roof, W goes up to the ridge).
- The station far behind the tracks is no longer something to stand on.
- **The camera** follows the villager in the air too, lifts up to keep them in view high in a tree, and no longer jitters while walking.

**Things to do** (**T**, the **✦ do** button, or ✦ on Android)
- A list of what can be done right where the villager stands: build a snowman or an igloo (whoever's walking along pitches in), a snow angel, a rest, a carol, tag, a team snowball fight, a light show, fireworks, the train to the ski slopes, a drive, cocoa, home, a wish. Use **1**–**9**, or the arrows and **Enter**.
- **Lie down in the snow** (**Z**): a moment's thought, the stars at night, then a doze. **Space** while lying makes a **snow angel**, pressed into the snow and slowly filled in. A kid nearby joins in with an angel of their own; a friend lies back beside the villager to look at the stars.
- **Igloos have rooms.** Crawl in through the tunnel to a dome of snow blocks, with a bench, furs to lie in, a little lamp, cocoa and an ice window. Whoever's inside already is there too.
- **Right-click a snowman or igloo** to knock it down (nobody minds).
- **Tag** with any kid, and a **carol** the neighbours gather round and join in.
- **Light shows** of any length (30 s to 15 min), and **fireworks**, from one rocket to a grand finale. The village's own light shows now wait longer for everyone to gather.
- **Team snowball fights:** the villager and everyone walking along with them (**F** invites people, as many as like) against the folk round about. The hits are counted and the winner goes on the scorecard.

**Games by the fire**
- In anyone's home (**T**, or right-click): **chess**, **checkers**, **Snowflakes** (a card game of colours and numbers: match, skip, turn about, draw two, and snowflakes that play on anything) and **Twenty-One**, against whoever lives there. Drawn in pixel art; arrows or the mouse to choose, Enter to play, Esc to get up.

**Trips out**
- **Skiing:** walk to the station and take the train up into the mountains to Pine Peak. Rent skis at the shop, ride the chairlift, then ski down the mountain: tuck for speed, jump the bumps (hold Space to go higher), dodge the pines, and go through the flags. The train brings the villager home again.
- **A drive:** the villager's car is parked by home. Take it out on a snowy night road (↑ to go, ← → to steer).

**The scorecard** (**I**, or right-click the villager) adds team snowball fights won and lost, tag games and tags, snow angels, carols, builds, light shows, fireworks, games won and lost, ski runs and the best time, kilometres driven, and how many times Santa got away.

**The village**
- **About five screens wide**, with open stretches of snow between groups of houses.
- **Villagers stay in the village.** People no longer walk off the end of the world: when it's time they go home, in at a front door, and new folk sometimes step out of one.
- **Villagers do more on their own:** snow angels, lying back to look at the stars at night, and kids playing tag with each other. Autopilot gets the new things too: snow angels, a rest in the snow, carols, and a sit in an igloo.
- **Speech bubbles show who's talking**, their name on the bubble's top edge, indoors too.
- **People and pets indoors** are drawn the same way as outside.
- **Click Santa five times quickly** and see what happens.

**Controls and looks**
- **Change the villager's keys:** click a [key] on the controls card (**?**) and press the new one.
- **The arrow keys choose** in every menu and in conversations (↑ ↓, Enter).
- **The app's own panels** (the settings, menus, conversations, the controls card and the games' table) can take the widgets' looks: Settings → Widgets → *Panels & menus*.
- **Trackpads:** two fingers up and down look into the sky and back, sideways along the village, and a pinch zooms. **Ctrl+wheel** zooms (it eases in, up to 4×), with **− +** buttons up by *centre*. **Shift+wheel** looks up into the sky.
- **[E] is less jumpy in a crowd.** The pet, the cabin's counter, home and a build come first, then whoever the villager's facing, and it stays on what it was on.
- **Drag the pet** about with the pointer, like everyone else.

**Saving**
- **A save file:** the village (so the houses and home are where they were at the next start) and the villager's pockets, stats and scorecard. It's written every minute and on the way out. Settings → Village → *export save* / *import save* to keep a copy or carry it to another computer.

**Window snow**
- On Windows, **hold the mouse button down** on the snow piled on a window and drag along: it rolls up into a growing snowball that stays sitting there.

**Installing on Linux**
- The installer puts the `xmas-tui` command on the PATH (`~/.local/bin`). It also offers to install kitty when it's missing and ffmpeg for the moving lock screen, asking first. Settings → Desktop has an *install ffmpeg* button, through the system's password prompt.

**Android**
- **One app on the home screen**, the game; the settings open from ⚙ in it.
- **The live wallpaper is the game's own village**, the villager on autopilot, sharing one save with the game, so each carries on from the other. *The wallpaper shows → classic* brings back the older one with the snowy dock.
- **Pixel-art controls**, a **✦** things-to-do button, held jumps, the joystick to choose in conversations, an option to **hide the controls** when they're not in use, and **game controller** support.

**On the web**
- **[dash1101.github.io/xmas-tui](https://dash1101.github.io/xmas-tui/)**: the same village in a browser, with keyboard and mouse, or touch controls on a phone. It saves in the browser; no sound yet.
